requirement: Complete browser consent with the observed OpenAI callback and strict Origin validation

oracle.invariant: The valid request redirects to sign-in and preserves its exact callback and resource without minting a session. Every invalid callback returns 400 invalid_request without a redirect. Both browser submissions carry the exact Tracy Origin and return the expected 303 callback. Allow stores one site-bound code, Cancel stores none. No referrer reaches the foreign fixture; null and foreign Origins remain 403 without additional codes.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)

OpenAI callback lookalikes and the obsolete callback are refused without redirect
browser consent allow: same-origin POST passes the strict Origin check without leaking a referrer
